title: Post-Apocalyptic Movies
intro: The world ended. Now comes the harder part, figuring out who we become in the wreckage.

films.title: The Road
films.line: A father and son walk through ash and silence toward something they can only call hope.

films.title: Children of Men
films.line: One man carries the weight of humanity's last chance through a world that has stopped believing.

films.title: 28 Days Later
films.line: Waking up alone into a broken city reveals that survival does terrifying things to people.

films.title: A Quiet Place
films.line: Love and terror live side by side when one single sound can end everything.

films.title: Annihilation
films.line: A team crosses into a zone where nature has rewritten the rules of what exists.

films.title: Snowpiercer
films.line: The last of humanity hurtles through a frozen world and class war ignites in every carriage.

films.title: I Am Legend
films.line: Alone in a silent city, one man carries the unbearable weight of being the last.
